title: Customer-Pay Repairs Discount Program Rate Table
content:
The Customer-Pay Repairs discount programs carry the following percentages, look-back, cap and base in each service tier.

| Service tier | Fleet (percent) | Military (percent) | Senior (percent) | Returning customer (percent) | Returning-customer look-back (calendar months) | Discount cap per repair order (USD) | Discount base |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 24 | 50.00 | total (the quoted total) |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 24 | 75.00 | total (the quoted total) |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 24 | 150.00 | labor only (the quoted labor) |
| Panel Repair Service | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 24 | 250.00 | labor only (the quoted labor) |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 8 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 24 | 500.00 | labor only (the quoted labor) |
| Complete Refinish Service | 5 | 10 | 5 | 0 | 24 | 750.00 | labor only (the quoted labor) |

## Column definitions

- **Fleet**: Discount for fleet accounts (percent).
- **Military**: Discount for active-duty military and veterans (percent).
- **Senior**: Discount for customers aged 65 or older (percent).
- **Returning customer**: Discount for a customer with a delivered repair in the look-back window (percent).
- **Look-back**: Calendar months back from the opening date within which a delivered repair makes the customer a returning customer (integer).
- **Discount cap**: Most any discount can be on one repair order (USD).
- **Discount base**: Amount the discount percentage applies to: total (the quoted total) or labor only (the quoted labor).

## Points of reading

- The military percentage (10), the senior percentage (5) and the look-back (24 calendar months) are the same in every tier.
- The fleet percentage steps down in the two highest tiers: 8 in Customer-Pay Collision Service and 5 in Complete Refinish Service.
- Complete Refinish Service carries a returning-customer percentage of 0.
- Paintless Dent Repair Service and Cosmetic Touch-Up Service apply their percentage to the quoted total; the four higher tiers apply it to the quoted labor only.
- Hypothetical reading: on a Panel Repair Service order with quoted labor of 1200.00 and a quoted total of 2100.00, the base is the 1200.00 of quoted labor; on a Cosmetic Touch-Up Service order with quoted labor of 150.00 and a quoted total of 320.00, the base is the 320.00 quoted total.
